description: Wallet risk check / address reputation for any Base address before you pay it or get paid by it: wallet age, balances, USDC in/out flows, x402-style (EIP-3009) payment history, wash-trading (round-trip) and self-funded-traction (concentration) flags, 0-100 score and verdict. Free teaser at /v1/wallet-xray/peek. Descriptive statistics of public chain data, not financial advice. PAID: $0.005 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Dex.

address.description: Base address to profile (wallet or contract)

hours.description: Look-back window for USDC flows in hours (1-72, default 12)

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

name: wallet_xray
title: Wallet X-Ray ($0.005)
